market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver would need to more than triple from ~$33 to $120 by June 2026 – an unprecedented move within 15 months. Even extreme bull markets haven’t sustained such a level, making the market’s 6.7% implied probability far too high.
evidence_points: All-time high silver settlement is ~$49 (1980, 2011); $120 is 2.4× that peak.
Current silver ~$33 would require a 264% rally in about 15 months.
No plausible fundamental or monetary catalyst could drive a 3x+ sustained price rise in that timeframe.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of silver futures market
